simple.summary: בָּהִיר (bâhîyr) means shining First listed occurrence: Job 37 21.

definitions.full: H925. bahir בָּהִירִ adjective bright, brilliant, of light ; only Job 37:21 בּ אוֺר רָאוּ ׳לֹא בַּשְּׁחָקִים הוּא .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to be bright);
